extracted.intended_audience: online course instructors, instructional designers, and higher-education quality-assurance administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and benchmark criteria for evaluating and designing quality online/distance education courses and programs in higher education, aimed at consumers, providers, and accreditors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended learning outcomes and entry requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: What are the intended learning outcomes, and what entry-level knowledge or skill is necessary for a reasonable chance of success?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consumers Guide level-1 basic information: guidelines anticipate suppliers provide written advice to students on these matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition upon completion
rubrics_metrics.description: What recognition will be awarded upon successful completion (e.g., transferable credits, degree, professional designation, etc.)?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1 consumer information to clarify credentialing and transferability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Necessary learning skills for success
rubrics_metrics.description: What are the necessary learning skills needed for success (e.g., the ability to write, to manage time, to take examinations, etc.)?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1 guidance for prospective students to self-assess readiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content coverage and sources
rubrics_metrics.description: What types of material are to be covered, and what are the sources and the relevance of this content?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1 consumer information: clarify scope and provenance of content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction and assignment format
rubrics_metrics.description: What is the format for instruction and assignments (i.e., group or individual)?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: specify delivery/interaction modes and assignment modalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructor identity and assessment responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Who will be teaching and assessing the students?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: disclose who provides instruction and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nature of assessments and success criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: What is the nature of the assessments, and what are the criteria for success?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: assessment types and clear criteria should be communicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course duration and timelines
rubrics_metrics.description: How long can the course be expected to take, including mandatory or flexible timelines?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: include expected time commitment and schedule flexibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum computer and operating system requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: What are the minimum computer and operational system requirements, and what options exist, if any?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: technical preconditions and alternatives should be stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required technical skills to access materials
rubrics_metrics.description: What technical skills will be required to access the course materials?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: specify prerequisite digital literacy/skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total costs and fees transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: What are the total costs, including tuition, books and materials, equipment, and other fees?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: full cost disclosure to consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credibility of the product and staff qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: How credible is the product? What are the qualifications of the design and delivery personnel, and how objective are the evaluation reports?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: provide evidence of credibility and professional qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration procedures and start information
rubrics_metrics.description: How does one get started? What are the complete registration procedures and services?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: clear onboarding/registration information for prospective students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical and content help contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: How does one get help? Who does one contact for technical assistance and content expertise?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: list support contacts and escalation paths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal and refund policies
rubrics_metrics.description: What are the policies for withdrawal and refunds?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-1: consumer protection details on cancellations/refunds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Systems reliability for learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Systems work consistently for the learner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2 evidence of good e-design and delivery: operational reliability is expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logical, well-organized navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Navigation is logical and well organized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: usability and information architecture to support learning access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevant, well-organized, interesting content
rubrics_metrics.description: Content is relevant, well organized and presented in an interesting manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: instructional content should engage and be pedagogically coherent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regularly updated materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials are updated on a regular basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: currency and maintenance of learning materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to learning resources and institutional services
rubrics_metrics.description: Access is provided to the learning resources, and advice is given on how to access institutional services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: ensure learners can find and use additional resources and services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalization options
rubrics_metrics.description: Learning packages allow options for individuals to personalize the course.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: customization/adaptability to individual learner needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduled expectations have pedagogical reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: Scheduled expectations (e.g., synchronous instruction and communication) are present for a reason.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: scheduling should be pedagogically justified, not arbitrary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ease of access to success requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: What learners need to succeed is easily accessible to them online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: transparent access to expectations, rubrics, and supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities to connect with instructor and peers
rubrics_metrics.description: There are ways to connect to the instructor and to other students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: mechanisms for interaction and community building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Varied assessment forms and clear criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of learning takes a variety of forms, and is conducted against clear, achievable criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-2: formative and summative assessments should be diversified and transparent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Students feel like valued customers
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals are made to feel like valued customers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: learner-centred service and respect in program interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible scheduling of registration/assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Scheduling of when to register, learn, and be assessed is flexible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: accommodate diverse learner time constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials are interesting and motivating
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials are interesting and motivating.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: instructional design should foster motivation and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bias-free approaches and materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Approaches and materials are free of cultural, racial, class, age, and gender bias.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: inclusive, culturally responsive materials and design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of prior skills for advanced credit
rubrics_metrics.description: Students are given opportunities to demonstrate current skills and knowledge for advanced credit or a shortened program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: recognition of prior learning and credit transfer options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of acquired skills and knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: The program provides a statement of acquired skills and knowledge, not just a completion certificate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: credentials should describe learning outcomes and competencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple approaches to appeal to different learning styles
rubrics_metrics.description: Various approaches are offered to appeal to different learning styles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: multimodal instruction to support diverse learners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to objective evaluation reports
rubrics_metrics.description: The institution provides access to objective evaluation reports on all delivery components: instructors, curriculum, student success, processes, and resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: transparency through external or internal evaluation reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Favourable benefit-to-cost demonstration
rubrics_metrics.description: Courses and programs demonstrate a favourable comparison of benefits to costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level-3: cost-effectiveness evidence for consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documented technology plan with security measures (NEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: A documented technology plan is in place that includes electronic security measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NEA 2000 benchmark: institutional-level IT planning and security for DE.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reliable delivery systems (NEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reliable delivery systems are in place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NEA 2000: operational infrastructure to ensure consistent access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centralized support for distance infrastructure (NEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Centralized support is available for building and maintaining the distance education infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NEA 2000: administrative support structures for sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program consistency with institutional mission (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each program is consistent with the institution’s mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET institutional context: ensure distance programs align with core institutional purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with accreditation and regulatory environments (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each program is compliant with the statement of accreditation, and with the regulatory environments in which it operates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: program-level regulatory and accreditation conformity is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional plan and budget demonstrate commitment (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: The institutional plan and budget demonstrates commitment to distance students and program sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: financial and planning evidence of institutional support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficient infrastructure and appropriate staffing (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sufficient infrastructure is available, and staffing is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: human and technical resources must match program needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization supports program design and student services (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: The organization of the institution supports the process of program design and approval, and coordinates student services for distance students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: structural support for DE program lifecycle and student services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articulation and transfer agreements consistency (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Articulation and transfer agreements are consistent with the guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: clear credit-transfer and articulation policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical systems and training programs are in place (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical systems and training programs are in place for staff, faculty, and students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: training and technical readiness across stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear communication of technical requirements and supports (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical requirements and the availability of support are communicated clearly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: transparency about required hardware/software and support expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Match between technology and program requirements (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: There is an explicit match between the technology used and the program requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: technology choices must serve pedagogical and program goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum course design standards driven by learning outcomes (WCET/NEA item 4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines are in place for minimum course design standards where learning outcomes (not technology) drive the content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course development benchmark: outcome-focused design standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Periodic review of instructional materials (NEA item 5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructional materials are reviewed periodically to ensure they meet program standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course development: maintain currency and quality control of materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Courses demand analysis, synthesis, and evaluation (NEA item 6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Courses are designed to require students to engage in analysis, synthesis and evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course development: ensure higher-order cognitive engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic rigour and qualified curriculum developers (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Academic rigour and breadth are assured through evidence from the approval processes, and by having academically qualified people define outcomes, develop curriculum, and determine assessment criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: uses approval processes and qualified personnel to maintain academic standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualified personnel responsible for presentation, management, assessment (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: In programs, presentation, management, and assessment are the responsibility of people with appropriate academic qualifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: ensure academically qualified staff manage core educational tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrated student interaction design (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appropriate student-to-student, and student and instructor interactions are demonstrated and evaluated to inform the delivery design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: document and evaluate interpersonal interaction patterns to shape delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear communication of program requirements (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Program requirements are communicated, including technical, financial, and time commitments. Career opportunities and certification parameters are communicated, clearly and honestly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: transparent pre-enrolment information about expectations and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium agreements specify expectations and oversight (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where consortium agreements exist, performance expectations, appropriate oversight, training, and benefits are specified, and conform to regulatory and quality assurance standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: collaborative arrangements require explicit governance and QA conformity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate student interaction in a variety of ways (NEA/WCET item 7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Student interaction with faculty and other students is facilitated in a variety of ways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaching/learning benchmark: provide multiple interaction channels and community-building activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constructive, timely feedback (NEA/WCET item 8)
rubrics_metrics.description: Feedback on student assignments and questions is constructive and provided in a timely manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaching/learning: timely formative feedback is essential to learning presence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction in effective research methods (NEA/WCET item 9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students are instructed in proper methods of effective research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaching/learning: embed information-literacy and research skill instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-course advisement about motivation and tech requirements (NEA/WCET item 10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Before starting, students are advised about the program so that they can determine if they have the motivation and commitment to learn at a distance, and the technology required by the course design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course structure: informed self-selection and readiness screening.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental course information and clear learning outcomes (NEA/WCET item 11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students are provided with supplemental course information that outlines the course objectives, concepts, and ideas; and learning outcomes for each course are summarized in a clear, straightforward written statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course structure: syllabi and course documents should clearly state objectives and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficient access to library resources (NEA/WCET item 12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students have sufficient access to library resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course structure: remote access to information resources is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement on expectations for completion and response times (NEA/WCET item 13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty and students agree on expectations about times for student assignment completion and faculty response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course structure: set mutual expectations for timelines and instructor responsiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive pre-admission information (NEA item 14 / WCET student support I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students receive information about programs, including admission requirements, tuition and fees, books and supplies, technical and proctoring requirements, and student support services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Student support: full disclosure pre-admission for informed decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hands-on training for electronic database access (NEA/WCET item 15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students are provided with hands-on training and information to aid them in securing material through electronic databases (and other sources).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Student support: build information access skills for online learners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing technical assistance and practice sessions (NEA/WCET item 16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical assistance is available throughout the course or program, including practice sessions prior to the beginning of the course and access to technical support staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Student support: continuous technical help and onboarding practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsive student support and complaint systems (NEA/WCET item 17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions directed to student support service personnel are answered accurately and quickly, and structured systems are in place to address student complaints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Student support: service level expectations and complaint handling procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs designed for specific student populations (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs are designed to meet the needs of specific student populations. Program plans, communications, and infrastructure demonstrate ongoing commitment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: program design should reflect target learner characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear communication of admission, technical, financial requirements (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Admission, technical, and financial requirements are communicated clearly prior to admission to the program, along with information on timeframes, the criteria of assessment, the availability of advisory and support services, and technical help.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET student support: comprehensive pre-enrolment communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remote access to appropriate support services (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students can access appropriate support services without coming to the physical campus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: support must be available remotely for distance learners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distance students are part of the academic community (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distance students are demonstrably part of the academic community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: integrate DE students into institutional academic life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance in course development for faculty (NEA item 18 / WCET faculty support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical assistance in course development is available to faculty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Faculty support: provide design/production resources to instructors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workload and compensation consistency; IP awareness (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Workload and compensation policies are consistent. Faculty are aware of intellectual property issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Faculty support: equitable policies and IP guidance for online teaching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance and assessment during transition to online instruction (NEA item 19)
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty members are assisted in the transition from classroom teaching to online instruction, and are assessed during the process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Faculty support: mentorship, evaluation, and transition support mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing instructor training, peer mentoring and course management support (NEA item 20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructor training and assistance, including peer mentoring, continues through the online course.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Faculty support: sustained professional development for online teaching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written resources for data-use issues (NEA item 21)
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty members are provided with written resources to deal with issues arising from student use of electronically accessed data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Faculty support: guidance on privacy, data use, and related student issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support available for direct service providers (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Support is available for those providing direct services to students, including training and mentoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: front-line student service staff receive training and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple-method program evaluation using specific standards (NEA item 22)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each program’s educational effectiveness and teaching/learning process is assessed through an evaluation process that uses several methods and applies specific standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation and assessment: use mixed methods and defined standards for program evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documented assessment of student achievement at course and program levels (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: As a component of the institution’s overall assessment activities, documented assessment of student achievement is conducted in each course and at the completion of the program by comparing student performance to the intended outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: align assessment practices to intended learning outcomes and program completion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of data on enrolment, costs, and tech uses to evaluate effectiveness (NEA item 23)
rubrics_metrics.description: Data on enrolment, costs, and successful or innovative uses of technology are used to evaluate program effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation: incorporate operational and innovation metrics in program reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure personal information and exam identification procedures (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: When examinations are employed, they are written in circumstances that include firm measures for student identification. Procedures are in place to secure personal information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: ensure academic integrity and privacy protections in assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regular review of intended learning outcomes (NEA item 24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Intended learning outcomes are reviewed regularly to ensure clarity, utility, and appropriateness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation: continuous revision of outcomes for relevance and clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall program effectiveness measurement (WCET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall program effectiveness is measured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WCET: aggregate evaluation across outcomes, processes, resources, and student success.
